invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, or throws an exception on error, so result should not be null at method exit.
The getWriteStatuses() should return a non-null list after a successful bulk insert.
The HoodieWriteMetadata parameterized type ensures write statuses are held in a List.
The returned list may be empty or non-empty, but it must be a valid List object.
